text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up  Robin joins as Engineering Manager next Mon 09:30 PT. Sharing a compact manager onboarding checklist + two nonstandard asks (petty cash/parking & budget access). Please confirm ownership by EOD Fri.

Maya (People Ops): Day-before essentials (short):
- Laptop + charger shipped and tracked
- Okta invite + MFA link sent
- Slack/email/calendar provisioned
- Notion access to /team/eng/managers and hiring folder
- 1Password manager vault access granted
- Welcome email with week-1 agenda queued

Zara (IT): Device imaged (MacBook Pro), shipping label created, ETA Fri 4pm. Will install dev image, VPN, Docker, VSCode. Confirming `eng-dev` group.

Dmitri (Eng): Start `eng-dev`. I can be Robin's buddy week 1 and run infra + repo walkthrough. Will prep a tiny first-PR onboarding task.

Priya (Finance): FYI managers get Concur access after payroll provisioning. Also confirm if Robin needs petty cash/parking card access? We can grant a department-level petty cash card for local team events.

Maya (People Ops): Yes please grant a petty cash access (dept-code ENG-OPS) and parking pass for month 1. Also add a 20m "budget primer" with Finance in week 1 so managers understand T&E + hiring budgets.

Dmitri (Eng): Suggest adding a 30-min "skip-level cafe" on Fri so team can meet Robin informally. Good way to catch culture signals early.

Maya (People Ops): Added. Minimal week-1 manager agenda (copyable):
Mon: 09:30 ops + quick welcome (10m), 10:00 team kickoff (30m), 15:00 director 1:1 (30m)
Tue: buddy shadow + infra walkthrough (60m)
Wed: product context with PM (30m), 20m team norms w/ tech leads
Thu: draft 30/60/90 + hiring rubric review (45m)
Fri: skip-level cafe + week1 retro (30m) + finance primer (20m)

onboard-bot: Reminder set: \"Robin - prestart checklist\" Fri 17:00 PT.

Zara (IT): :white_check_mark: Device imaged & shipped, `eng-dev` added. Will DM tracking.

Dmitri (Eng): :white_check_mark: Buddy + first-PR task ready.

Priya (Finance): :white_check_mark: Concur approval created and petty cash parking pass request submitted (ENG-OPS). Will confirm once provisioning completes.

Robin (new-manager): Thanks team! Quick Q: can I get the 1:1 note template and the hiring bar link before Thu? I want to draft my 30/60/90.

Maya (People Ops): Dropping 1:1 template and hiring rubric into Notion now, will DM links to Robin. Please react with :white_check_mark: when items are complete so I can close the checklist.

Maya (People Ops): Closing note  will publish consolidated Notion page and DM calendar invites once all checks are green. Thanks everyone.
